justification: Native metadata inventory identified managed defaults but free caller-supplied output destinations. Validate selected operational entry points before training, Docker or state/credential creation without rewriting scientific/internal APIs.
behavior: Outputs must be children of the designated checkout data area.
Reject parent traversal, sibling areas, symlink ancestors/leaves including dangling links, and non-directory ancestors.
Validation creates no directories; performed before expensive work.
No runtime-root environment override was introduced.
Internal APIs keep explicit caller paths for fixtures and controlled integrations.
REPORTS_DIR and FIGURES_DIR now default to data/reports; no existing outputs moved.

full_suite_before_test_correction.failure: Old catalogue test asserted exactly 12 destinations; data/reports adds the 13th.
full_suite_before_test_correction.resolution: Replaced fixed count with required destination coverage, configured reports coverage, and legacy-root review checks. Production code unchanged after broad run.

limits: Coverage is partial: other CLIs, internal APIs and dependency caches are not confined by this helper.
Path preflight is not an OS sandbox or protection against concurrent symlink replacement.
No new service or model evaluation, no claim that all library writes are confined.
next_gate: Native focused tox validation, then isolated PostgreSQL/S3 MLflow service rehearsal without cutover to historical consumers.
